verses.geez:
ወቆመ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ አቢሜሌክ ፡ ዘያድኅኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ቶላ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ፉሐ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ብእሲ
                  ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ይስካር ፡ ወውእቱሰ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማርያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.translation: And after Abimelech Thola the son of Phua rose up to save Israel, being the son of his father's brother, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Samir in mount Ephraim.

translations.lxx: And after Abimelech Thola the son of Phua rose up to save Israel, being the son of his father's brother, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Samir in mount Ephraim.
translations.kjv: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
translations.ron: După Abimelec s-a ridicat ca să izbăvească pe Israel Tola, fiul lui Pua, fiul lui Dodo, din seminţia lui Isahar. Acesta trăia în Şamir, pe muntele lui Efraim.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστη μετὰ Ἀβιμέλεχ τοῦ σῶσαι τὸν Ἰσραὴλ Θωλὰ υἱὸς Φουὰ, υἱὸς πατραδέλφου αὐτοῦ, ἀνὴρ Ἰσσάχαρ· καὶ αὐτὸς ᾤκει ἐν Σαμὶρ ἐν ὄρει Ἐφραίμ.

verses.geez: ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ዕሥራ ፡ ወሠለስተ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ ወተቀብረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማርያ ።
verses.translation: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Samir.

translations.lxx: And he judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Samir.
translations.kjv: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
translations.ron: Şi a fost el judecătorul lui Israel douăzeci şi trei de ani şi; murind, a fost îngropat în Şamir.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκρινε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ εἴκοσι τρία ἔτη, καὶ ἀπέθανε, καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Σαμίρ.

verses.geez: ወቆመ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ፡ ኢይእር ፡ ገላአዳዊ ፡ ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ዕሥራ ፡ ወክልኤተ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And after him arose Jair of Galaad, and he judged Israel twenty-two years.

translations.lxx: And after him arose Jair of Galaad, and he judged Israel twenty-two years.
translations.kjv: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
translations.ron: După dânsul s-a sculat Iair din Galaad şi a fost judecător lui Israel douăzeci şi doi de ani.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστη μετʼ αὐτὸν Ἰαῒρ ὁ Γαλαὰδ, καὶ ἔκρινε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ εἴκοσι δύο ἔτη.

verses.geez:
ወቦ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ወክልኤተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ወይጼዐኑ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ አእዱግ ፡ ወቦሙ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡
                  አህጉረ ፡ ወሰመዮን ፡ ዳብራተ ፡ ዘኢያኢር ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወሀለዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ።
verses.translation: And he had thirty-two sons riding on thirty-two colts, and they had thirty-two cities; and they called them Jair's towns until this day in the land of Galaad.

translations.lxx: And he had thirty-two sons riding on thirty-two colts, and they had thirty-two cities; and they called them Jair's towns until this day in the land of Galaad.
translations.kjv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
translations.ron: Acesta a avut treizeci şi doi de fii, care călăreau pe treizeci şi doi de asini şi aveau treizeci şi două de cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν αὐτῷ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο υἱοὶ ἐπιβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τριάκοντα δύο πώλους· καὶ τριάκοντα δύο πόλεις αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὰς ἐπαύλεις Ἰαῒρ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἐν γῇ Γαλαάδ.

verses.translation: And Jair died, and was buried in Rhamnon.

translations.lxx: And Jair died, and was buried in Rhamnon.
translations.kjv: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
translations.ron: Murind Iair, a fost îngropat în Camon.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἰαῒρ, καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν Ῥαμνών.

verses.geez:
ወደገሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ገቢረ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአምለክዎ ፡ ለበዓልም ፡ ወለአስጠሮት ፡
                  ወአማልክተ ፡ ሶርያ ፡ ወአማልክተ ፡ ሲዶና ፡ ወአማልክተ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ወአማልክተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወአማልክተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡
                  ወኀደግዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢተቀንዩ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Astaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Phylistines; and they forsook the Lord, and did not serve him.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Astaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Phylistines; and they forsook the Lord, and did not serve him.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
translations.ron: Dar fiii lui Israel au făcut iarăşi rele înaintea ochilor Domnului şi au slujit baalilor şi astartelor şi dumnezeilor Amoreilor, dumnezeilor Sidonului, dumnezeilor Amoniţilor, dumnezeilor Moabiţilor şi dumnezeilor Filistenilor, iar pe Domnul L-au părăsit şi nu L-au slujit.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέθεντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιον Κυρίου, καὶ ἐδούλευσαν τοῖς Βααλὶμ, καὶ ταῖς Ἀσταρὼθ, καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Ἀρὰμ, καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Σιδῶνος, καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Μωὰβ, καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς υἱῶν Ἀμμὼν, καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς Φυλιστιῒμ, καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον τὸν Κύριον, καὶ οὐκ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወተምዕዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአግብኦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ።
verses.translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of the Phylistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

translations.lxx: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of the Phylistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
translations.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a aprins mânia Domnului asupra lui Israel, şi l-a dat în mâinile Filistenilor şi în mâinile Amoniţilor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ Κύριος ἐν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ Φυλιστιῒμ, καὶ ἐν χειρὶ υἱῶν Ἀμμών.

verses.geez: ወሣቀይዎሙ ፡ ወአጠቅዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ በምድረ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ በገላአድ ።
verses.translation: And they afflicted and bruised the children of Israel at that time eighteen years, all the children of Israel beyond Jordan in the land of the Amorite in Galaad.

translations.lxx: And they afflicted and bruised the children of Israel at that time eighteen years, all the children of Israel beyond Jordan in the land of the Amorite in Galaad.
translations.kjv: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
translations.ron: Aceştia au strâmtorat ţi au chinuit pe fiii lui Israel din anul acela optsprezece ani în şir, adică pe toţi fiii lui Israel de dincolo de Iordan, din ţara Amoreilor, care este în Galaad.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθλιψαν καὶ ἔθλασαν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ὀκτωκαίδεκα ἔτη, τοὺς πάντας υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐν γῇ τοῦ Ἀμοῤῥὶ τοῦ ἐν Γαλαάδ.

verses.geez:
ወዐደዉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ይትቃተልዎሙ ፡ ለይሁዳ ፡ ወለብንያም ፡ ወለቤተ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወተሣቀዩ ፡ ደቂቀ
                  ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan to fight with Juda, and Benjamin, and with Ephraim; and the children of Israel were greatly afflicted.

translations.lxx: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan to fight with Juda, and Benjamin, and with Ephraim; and the children of Israel were greatly afflicted.
translations.kjv: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
translations.ron: Iar Amoniţii au trecut Iordanul, ca să se războiască cu Iuda, cu Veniamin şi cu casa lui Efraim. Aşa că fiii lui Israel erau foarte strâmtoraţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ διέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀμμὼν τὸν Ἰορδάνην παρατάξασθαι πρὸς Ἰούδαν, καὶ Βενιαμὶν, καὶ πρὸς Ἐφραίμ· καὶ ἐθλίβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ σφόδρα.

verses.geez:
ወገዐሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ አበስነ ፡ ለከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀደግናከ ፡ አምላክነ ፡
                  ወአምለክናሆሙ ፡ ለበዓልም ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, because we have forsaken God, and served Baalim.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, because we have forsaken God, and served Baalim.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
translations.ron: Atunci au strigat fiii lui Israel către Domnul şi au zis: "Greşit-am înaintea Ta, pentru că am părăsit pe Dumnezeul nostru şi am slujit baalilor".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐβόησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Κύριον, λέγοντες, ἡμάρτομέν σοι, ὅτι ἐγκατελίπομεν τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ ἐδουλεύσαμεν τῷ Βααλίμ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አኮኑ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወአሞሬዎን ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወሞአብ ፡ ወኢሎፍሊ
                  ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Did I not save you from Egypt and from the Amorite, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Phylistines,

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Did I not save you from Egypt and from the Amorite, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Phylistines,
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
translations.ron: Domnul însă a zis către fiii lui Israel: "Nu v-au împilat oare Egiptenii, Amoreii, Amoniţii şi Filistenii,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ, μὴ οὐχὶ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἀμοῤῥαίου, καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἀμμὼν, καὶ ἀπὸ Φυλιστιῒμ,

verses.geez: ወሲዶና ፡ ወምድያም ፡ ወዐማሌቅ ፡ ሣቀዩክሙ ፡ ወገዐርክሙ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወአድኀንኩክሙ ፡ እምእዴሆሙ ።
verses.translation: and from the Sidonians, and Amalec, and Madiam, who afflicted you? and ye cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand?

translations.lxx: and from the Sidonians, and Amalec, and Madiam, who afflicted you? and ye cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand?
translations.kjv: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
translations.ron: Sidonienii, Amaleciţii şi Moabiţii, şi când aţi strigat către Mine, nu v-am izbăvit Eu oare din mâinile lor?
translations.grk: καὶ Σιδωνίων, καὶ Ἀμαλὲκ, καὶ Μαδιὰμ, οἳ ἔθλιψαν ὑμᾶς; καὶ ἐβοήσατε πρὸς μὲ, καὶ ἔσωσα ὑμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῶν;

verses.geez: ወአንትሙሰ ፡ ኀደግሙኒ ፡ ወአምለክሙ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ አማልክተ ፤ በበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኢያድኅነክሙ ።
verses.translation: Yet ye forsook me and served other gods; therefore I will not save you any more.

translations.lxx: Yet ye forsook me and served other gods; therefore I will not save you any more.
translations.kjv: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
translations.ron: Dar voi M-aţi părăsit iarăşi şi v-aţi apucat să slujiţi la alţi dumnezei. De aceea nu vă voi mai izbăvi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐγκατελίπετέ με, καὶ ἐδουλεύσατε θεοῖς ἑτέροις· διὰ τοῦτο οὐ προσθήσω τοῦ σῶσαι ὑμᾶς.

verses.geez: ሑሩ ፡ ጽርሑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አማልክት ፡ እለ ፡ ኀሬክሙ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ወያድኅኑክሙ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ ምንዳቤክሙ ።
verses.translation: Go, and cry to the gods whom ye have chosen to yourselves, and let them save you in the time of your affliction.

translations.lxx: Go, and cry to the gods whom ye have chosen to yourselves, and let them save you in the time of your affliction.
translations.kjv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
translations.ron: Mergeţi şi strigaţi către dumnezeii pe care vi i-aţi ales; să vă izbăvească aceia la vreme de necaz!"
translations.grk: Πορεύεσθε, καὶ βοήσατε πρὸς τοὺς θεοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξασθε ἑαυτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ σωσάτωσαν ὑμᾶς ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አበስነ ፡ ረስየነ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ትፈቅድ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ እግዚኦ
                  ፡ አድኅነነ ፡ በዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We have sinned: do thou to us according to all that is good in thine eyes; only deliver us this day.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We have sinned: do thou to us according to all that is good in thine eyes; only deliver us this day.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Israel au zis către Domnul: "Greşit-am! Fă cu noi cum vei crede că e mai bine, numai izbăveşte-ne şi acum".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Κύριον, ἡμάρτομεν, ποίησον σὺ ἡμῖν κατὰ πὰν τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου, πλὴν ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez:
ወአሰሰሉ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ወአምለክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአሥመርዎ ፡ ወዐንበዙ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ሥቃይ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And they put away the strange gods from the midst of them, and served the Lord only, and his soul was pained for the trouble of Israel.

translations.lxx: And they put away the strange gods from the midst of them, and served the Lord only, and his soul was pained for the trouble of Israel.
translations.kjv: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi au lepădat de la ei pe dumnezeii cei străini şi au început să slujească numai Domnului. Şi S-a îndurat Domnul de suferinţele lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξέκλιναν τοὺς θεοὺς τοὺ ἀλλοτρίους ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐδούλευσαν τῷ Κυρίῳ μόνῳ· καὶ ὠλιγώθη ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐν κόπῳ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወዐርጉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ወወፅኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡
                  መሴፋ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon went up, and encamped in Galaad; and the children of Israel were gathered together and encamped on the hill.

translations.lxx: And the children of Ammon went up, and encamped in Galaad; and the children of Israel were gathered together and encamped on the hill.
translations.kjv: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
translations.ron: Amoniţii însă s-au adunat şi şi-au aşezat tabăra în Galaad. S-au adunat de asemenea şi fiii lui Israel şi au tăbărât la Miţpa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀμμὼν, καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν Γαλαάδ· καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ σκοπίᾳ.

verses.geez:
ወተባሀሉ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ በበ ፡ በይናቲሆሙ ፡ መኑ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይእኅዝ ፡ ይትቃተሎሙ ፡ ለነ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ርኡሰ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ።
verses.translation: And the people the princes of Galaad said every man to his neighbour, Who is he that shall begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall even be head over all that dwell in Galaad.

translations.lxx: And the people the princes of Galaad said every man to his neighbour, Who is he that shall begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall even be head over all that dwell in Galaad.
translations.kjv: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
translations.ron: Atunci poporul şi căpeteniile Galaadului au zis unii către alţii: "Cine va începe lupta contra Amoniţilor acela va fi căpetenie peste toţi locuitorii Galaadului".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπον ὁ λαὸς οἱ ἄρχοντες Γαλαὰδ, ἀνὴρ πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ ἀνὴρ ὅστις ἂν ἄρξεται παρατάξασθαι πρὸς υἱοῖς Ἀμμὼν, καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἄρχοντα πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσι Γαλαάδ;
